statements.chinese: 我只是——不想让我们仓促投入一段还没准备好的关系。

statements.english: I really don't want to mess up what we have
statements.chinese: 我真的不想搞砸我们现有的关系。

statements.english: I'm just-I'm worried it's gonna be a big mistake
statements.chinese: 我只是——我担心这会是个大错。

statements.english: Which is why my answer is yes !
statements.chinese: 正因如此，我的回答是肯定的！

statements.english: Really ?!
statements.chinese: 真的吗？！

statements.english: Uh-huh ! I'm so ... happy
statements.chinese: 嗯哼！我真是...太开心了。

statements.english: Monica ! Stop throwing it so hard !
statements.chinese: Monica！别扔那么用力！

statements.english: We're on the same team !
statements.chinese: 我们是同一队的！

statements.english: Four hours ? You guys have been doing this for four hours ?
statements.chinese: 四个小时？你们这帮人已经干了四个小时了？

been.definition: be（过去分词）: 构成现在完成进行时

statements.english: That's right baby
statements.chinese: 没错宝贝。

statements.english: All right , let me in
statements.chinese: 好吧，让我进去。

statements.english: No-no ! Don't do it ! Don't !
statements.chinese: 不行不行！别这么做！不要！

statements.english: What ?
statements.chinese: 什么？

statements.english: He's a dropper !
statements.chinese: 他是个掉链子的家伙！

statements.english: Oh yeah , that's right !
statements.chinese: 哦对，没错！

statements.english: I'm not a dropper !
statements.chinese: 我才不是个半途而废的人！

statements.english: It's really a uh-uh three person game , y'know ?
statements.chinese: 这其实是个三人游戏，懂吧？

statements.english: It's throwing and catching !
statements.chinese: 这是投掷与接球的游戏！

statements.english: All right
statements.chinese: 好的。

statements.english: Oh ! Oh ! That's so hard
statements.chinese: 哎呀！哎呀！这也太难了。

statements.english: Whoa-whoa you guys , it's not a cat !
statements.chinese: 喂喂，各位，这不是猫！

statements.english: Oh my-Oh good God !
statements.chinese: 天啊—上帝啊！

statements.english: I give up you guys , I don't know what I'm going to do with this thing !
statements.chinese: 我放弃你们了，我真不知道该怎么处理这个东西！

statements.english: Baking it didn't help , huh ?
statements.chinese: 烤了也没用，是吧？

statements.english: So , why don't you just take it back to where you got it ?
statements.chinese: 那你为什么不直接把它退回原处呢？

statements.english: I tried ! They won't take her back
statements.chinese: 我试过了！他们不肯收留她。

statements.english: Maybe that's because she's a minion of the anti-Christ
statements.chinese: 或许因为她是反基督者的爪牙。

statements.english: Rach , why won't they take it back ?
statements.chinese: Rach，他们为什么不肯退货？

statements.english: Well , they said would but they would only give me store credit
statements.chinese: 嗯，他们说是会赔偿，但只同意给我店铺积分。

statements.english: I mean , what am I going to do , get a thousand regular cats ?
statements.chinese: 我是说，我还能怎么办，难道要养一千只普通的猫吗？

statements.english: Look , if you want you can keep it at our place
statements.chinese: 听着，如果你想的话，可以把它放在我们这儿。

statements.english: until you find out what to do with it
statements.chinese: 直到你找到处理它的方法。

statements.english: No Mon that's not the point . I'm out a thousand dollars
statements.chinese: 不是这样的Mon，问题不在这里。我损失了一千美元。

statements.english: I'm all scratched up
statements.chinese: 我浑身是伤，

statements.english: and I'm stuck with this stupid cat that looks like a hand !
statements.chinese: 而我却被这只长得像只手的蠢猫给缠住了！

looks.definition: look（第三人称单数）: 看起来

statements.english: Oh my God , the cat's made my eyes water !
statements.chinese: 天啊，这只猫让我眼泪都流出来了！

statements.english: Don't-don't throw it to me !
statements.chinese: 别—别扔给我！

statements.english: My vision's been compromised !!
statements.chinese: 我的视力受损了！！

been.definition: be（过去分词）: 构成完成时

statements.english: Oh God ! Okay . Okay . It's okay
statements.chinese: 天啊！好了好了。没事的。

statements.english: Man , that was close
statements.chinese: 天啊，真是千钧一发。

statements.english: Yeah , you almost overreacted to something
statements.chinese: 是啊，你差点对某件事反应过度了。

statements.english: We have great news !
statements.chinese: 我们有个好消息！

statements.english: We're moving in together ! Isn't it great ! Yay !
statements.chinese: 我们要同居啦！是不是很棒！耶！

statements.english: Congratulations ! Congrats !
statements.chinese: 恭喜！祝贺！

statements.english: I know , I'm so excited !
statements.chinese: 我知道，我太兴奋了！

statements.english: So am I !
statements.chinese: 我也是！

am.definition: be（现在时第一人称单数）: 是

statements.english: Well , you're not more excited than I am !
statements.chinese: 哈，你可没我这么兴奋！

statements.english: No way ! I'm the most excited !
statements.chinese: 不可能！我才是最兴奋的那个！

statements.english: Okay , I'll see you at the station later
statements.chinese: 好的，我们稍后在车站见。

statements.english: Okay , yeah , I'll see you later ! Don't forget about the moving in !
statements.chinese: 好的，一会儿见！别忘了搬家的事！

statements.english: So you're moving in with him . What happened ?
statements.chinese: 所以你要搬去和他一起住了？发生什么事了？

statements.english: I couldn't tell him no . He got so sad
statements.chinese: 我实在不忍心拒绝他。他看起来难过极了。

statements.english: Maybe it'll be all right
statements.chinese: 也许一切都会好起来的。

statements.english: I do really like him a lot
statements.chinese: 我确实非常喜欢他

statements.english: and probably do it eventually anyway
statements.chinese: 而且很可能最终还是会这么做

statements.english: and plus , think of all the money I'll save on stamps
statements.chinese: 更何况，想想我还能省下不少邮票钱呢。

statements.english: Why , do you write him a lot ?
statements.chinese: 怎么，你经常给他写信吗？

statements.english: No , I just heard when people live together
statements.chinese: 不，我只是听说当人们同居时，

statements.english: they split the cost of stamps . Don't they ?
statements.chinese: 他们分摊了邮票的费用，不是吗？

statements.english: - Yeah ! That's right . - Yeah-yeah ! Yeah !
statements.chinese: - 没错！就是这样。- 对对！就是！

statements.english: Oh , I'm sorry , the oven mitts really freaked me out
statements.chinese: 噢，抱歉，那个烤箱手套真的把我吓坏了。

statements.english: Hey , honey !
statements.chinese: 嘿，亲爱的！

statements.english: Okay , so did you find any apartments ? Anything in Brooklyn Heights ?
statements.chinese: 好的，那你找到什么公寓了吗？Brooklyn Heights那边有合适的吗？

did.definition: do（过去式）: 构成疑问句
